headline: Committee approves amendment on property criteria, 5–4

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.voteItem: A member's amendment to the criteria proposal (majority impacted; shoreline rules; not originally meant for affordable workforce housing)
meeting.summary: Members voted 5–4 to approve an amendment on sea-level rise and housing criteria and will reconvene September 9 at 10 a.m.
meeting.recap: The meeting came back from a recess.[[0:10:00]] The recess gave the council chair time to decide whether to support the proposed criteria.[[0:11:32]] The chair agreed that "significantly impacted" means 51% or more.[[0:12:14]] One member said "significantly impacted" was subjective and asked for a clear standard the public could understand.[[0:12:53]] A speaker suggested the word "majority" instead of "significant.".[[0:14:25]] The amendment said structures must be mostly impacted by 3.2 feet of sea-level rise, or fall under shoreline rules or a special flood hazard area.[[0:15:06]] It also said the property must not have first been meant for affordable workforce housing.[[0:15:17]] The amendment passed on a roll call vote, five ayes to four noes.[[0:17:30]] A member began proposing another criterion about how many units residents lived in during 2008.[[0:19:15]] Members were unsure whether it meant owner-occupied homes or homes lived in by residents.[[0:20:35]] The member said they would likely wait until the next session to offer it.[[0:23:12]] The committee will pick up again on September 9 at 10 a.m.[[0:24:05]] The criteria will be included in the resolution as a clause.[[0:24:19]] Staff offered to work with the member on drafting the new criterion before then.[[0:24:46]]
decided: The amendment to the criteria motion passed on a roll call vote, five ayes to four noes.
meeting.next: Members can propose more criteria when the committee reconvenes. Staff offered to work with the member on drafting the new criterion before the committee reconvenes.

moments.q: "Is that how we're defining significantly 51% or more?"
"Chair, that's five ayes, four nos, motion passes."
Committee sets reconvene date of September 9 at 10 a.m.

issues.oneLine: The committee is setting criteria for properties, including whether a property was first meant for affordable workforce housing.
issues.why: A member said clear, objective criteria would help the public and the administration when the result goes to the Planning Commission.
issues.next: Members can propose more criteria when the committee reconvenes.
issues.brief: The amendment said the property must not have first been meant for affordable workforce housing.[[#1]] The amendment passed five ayes to four noes.[[#2]] A member wants a criterion based on how many units residents lived in during 2008.[[#3]] The criteria will be included in the resolution as a clause.[[#4]]
